drag_load.governs: Drag load DR: gamma 1.10 strength (structural), 0.00 geotechnical, 1.00 Service I

psc_axial.governs: Factored axial resistance Pr = phi Pn, spiral-reinforced prestressed pile

biaxial.governs: Biaxial flexure with compression of noncircular members

strain_compat.governs: Interaction by equilibrium and strain compatibility; net tensile strain

tension_psc.governs: Tension resistance Pr = phi Aps (fpe + fy) <= phi Aps fpy, fy = 60 ksi without nonprestressed steel

service_comp.governs: Compressive stress limit 0.60 phi_w f'c at the service limit state

service_tens.governs: Tensile stress limit; severe corrosive limit for Extremely Aggressive substructures

prestress_min.governs: Driving strength >= 5.0 ksi; uniform compression >= 0.7 ksi after losses

prestress_fdot.governs: Standard piles designed for about 1000 psi uniform compression after losses

std_plans.governs: Alternate strand patterns, jacking forces, spiral, dowels

min_pile_size.governs: Minimum square pile size: pedestrian bridges 14 in (18 in with carbon-steel strand in Extremely Aggressive)

pile_spacing.governs: Center-to-center spacing >= 3.0 pile diameters at and below design ground

head_connection.governs: 48 in embedment develops the full pile bending; solid pile >= 8 ft; tension pile details

splice.governs: Mechanical splice bending strength (a splice must develop the pile)

lateral_fbmp.governs: Lateral analysis by FB-MultiPier, resistance factor 1.0

pipe_axial.governs: Axial compression resistance of noncomposite pipe: Pn = 0.658^(Po/Pe) Po or 0.877 Pe

pipe_local.governs: Circular-tube slenderness 0.11 E/Fy and effective area

fixity.governs: Effective length = unsupported length + depth to fixity

pipe_flexure.governs: Flexural resistance of circular tubes: compact, noncompact and slender

pipe_shear.governs: Flexural shear resistance of round tubes

pipe_tension.governs: Tension: yielding on the gross section, phi_y = 0.95

steel_grade.governs: Steel pipe piling ASTM A252 Grade 3 (Fy 45 ksi) or API 5L

corrosion.governs: Corrosion and section loss allowance; environment classification

exposure.governs: Environment classification governs covers and materials

nbr.governs: Required nominal bearing resistance Rn >= (FDL + net scour resistance + downdrag)/phi

driving_max.governs: Maximum pile driving resistance for prestressed concrete piles

phi_geo.governs: Geotechnical resistance factors for driven piles (replaces LRFD Table 10.5.5.2.3-1)

downdrag_plans.governs: Show downdrag on the plans; neglect pile self-weight in the nominal bearing resistance

data_table.governs: Pile Data Table columns A to Q and rounding

min_tip.governs: Minimum tip elevation for uplift and lateral stability

fbmp_model.governs: Pile forces from the nonlinear FBMP analysis
